Sync your backpack from Steam
  1. Only once: drag this button to your bookmarks bar: Send to the Mann-ual
  2. On the Steam page that just opened (open it again), click the Send to the Mann-ual bookmark
  3. That's it: your backpack comes back here by itself
Signed in to Steam, it reads your own backpack even when it's private. Rather do it by hand? Copy and paste it instead.
One more step. This page can't reach Steam by itself here.
  1. Open your backpack data (a page of plain text opens)
  2. Press Ctrl+A, then Ctrl+C
  3. Come back here and press Ctrl+V anywhere
